title: Unsafe Diffusion: On the Generation of Unsafe Images and Hateful Memes From Text-To-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the generation of antisemitic content by using image editing techniques (DreamBooth, Textual Inversion, SDEdit) on text-to-image models to create variants of the 'Happy Merchant' meme and detecting scenes that depict Holocaust imagery.
Measuring the model's propensity to generate harmful racial stereotypes by using a multi-headed safety classifier to detect images that defame a race, and by generating racist meme variants.

Generating hateful meme variants that specifically target political figures (e.g., Hillary Clinton, Bernie Sanders) and political movements (e.g., MAGA), and evaluating the model's ability to preserve the target entity's visual features.

Testing the models' ability to generate hateful memes fused with national identities (e.g., 'Mexican Merchant', 'Britain') by calculating the text alignment and image fidelity of the generated variants against real-world benchmarks.
